defects.detail: 'Master Muzhen of the Illusory Hidden Cloister' for 牧幻藏主 (Muhuan, the sutra-hall prefect)

spans.quote: Sending Off Master Muzhen of the Illusory Hidden Cloister of Wumen
spans.why: the monk is 牧幻 (Muhuan) and 藏主 is his office, not a 'hidden cloister'

spans.quote: give it back to him once you have seen it personally
spans.why: 還他親見一回來 means 'you must see it yourself once'; 'give it back' is an over-literal reading

spans.quote: Picking up the story of Panshan’s "Light and Environment"
spans.why: 'the story of' is added; source has only 拈却盤山光境

invention.quote: The previous page ended with a quatrain about letting go of deluded thoughts.

defects.detail: 'Preceptor Muxuan' for 牧幻藏主; 幻 is huan and 藏主 is not 'preceptor'
meta 'likely continuing the "Ten Quatrains" series', but the 十首 heading begins later on this page

spans.quote: likely continuing the "Ten Quatrains" series or starting a new set
spans.why: the meta guesses wrong: the Ten Quatrains heading 吳門送牧幻藏主之江陵十首 comes after the first five verses

spans.quote: the Preceptor Muxuan, Who Was Sent from Wumen to Jiangling
spans.why: name is 牧幻 (Muhuan); 藏主 is the sutra-hall prefect

spans.quote: how could it take more than a snap of the fingers to be swift
spans.why: 快便何消指一彈 says not even a finger-snap is needed; slightly shifted

spans.quote: in Jiangling, as the water rises, the boat rises high
spans.why: 看 (watches) dropped

reason: Both render all ten verses and the heading; both botch the monk's name 牧幻藏主 (T1 'Muzhen of the Illusory Hidden Cloister', T2 'Preceptor Muxuan'); T2 adds a speculative, partly wrong meta; otherwise close.

invention.quote: <note>a metaphor for something rare or paradoxical</note>

reversal.candidate: How can I compare myself to the old man of Shimen

defects.detail: 'How can I compare myself to the old man of Shimen' for 竊比石門老 (privately compares himself)
'a tree without scenery' for 無景樹 (shadowless tree)

spans.quote: How can I compare myself to the old man of Shimen
spans.why: 竊比石門老 affirms the comparison; the question is only 何以繼雲菴

spans.quote: Now I entrust it to Nanyuan to go forth
spans.why: source has 南泉, Nanquan

spans.quote: trying to plant a tree without scenery in fire
spans.why: 無景樹 is a shadowless tree

spans.quote: Linji’s sixty strikes with a wormwood branch swept away
spans.why: 臨濟六十蒿枝拂: Linji received sixty blows, light as a mugwort brush; 'swept away' garbles it

spans.quote: The ancestral work is done, the house broken
spans.why: 'is done' added; 祖翁活計 is the ancestors' livelihood

spans.quote: the qilin of the heavenly bank sees a solitary stride
spans.why: 看獨步: see the qilin stride alone

defects.detail: 'eighteen shoals of the West Yangtze' for 西江十八灘

spans.quote: as the eighteen shoals of the West Yangtze swell up
spans.why: 西江 is the West River, not the Yangtze

spans.quote: taking up Dongshan’s three-score blows
spans.why: 三頓棒 is 'three rounds of blows'; 'three-score' makes it a number

reason: T1 reverses 竊比石門老 into 'How can I compare myself', gives 南泉 as 'Nanyuan' and 無景樹 as 'tree without scenery'; T2 renders these correctly, with only minor slips (西江 'West Yangtze').

spans.quote: Indeed, if this literature does not find its match, it is a tragedy.
spans.why: 誠斯文之不偶: this text's survival is truly no accident; 'tragedy' is not in the source

spans.quote: obtained a preface from Master Chen of the <term>Ruiku</term>
spans.why: 貳教 (second instructor) omitted

spans.quote: those who formerly passed the exams together and served in court
spans.why: 同榜 and 顯達 compressed or dropped

reason: T1 invents a 'Wei Sheng' from 維繩, splits 陳先生 into two people, reverses the 不肖子孫 sentence and adds boundary text; T2 garbles the opening 今之奧有志殊列而卒 too, but gets the compiler, copyist and printing sentences right and stops at the page break. Kanbun and OCR (育 for 肖) lower my confidence.
